metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover around Depok lower in 2019 than in 1990?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing vegetation cover around Depok (Indonesia) between 2019 and 1990. 1. **Search Strategy**: - Location: Depok, Indonesia (need to define a geometry around Depok) - Time periods: 1990 and 2019 - Data: Need vegetation index - NDVI is the most common. Landsat 5 would be good for 1990, Landsat 8 for 2019. - I'll use a 10km buffer around Depok to capture "around Depok" 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Need to mask clouds for both years to get clean vegetation data - Use the standard cloud masking functions for Landsat 3. **Logic**: - Calculate mean NDVI for both years - Compare if 2019 NDVI < 1990 NDVI - Need to check for empty collections and valid pixels Potential issues: - Landsat 5 started in 1984, so 1990 should be fine - Need to handle different sensors (Landsat 5 vs Landsat 8) - Should use similar seasons to avoid seasonal bias ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const depok = ee.Geometry.Point([106.8186, -6.4025]); // Depok, Indonesia const region = depok.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Depok // Time periods - using similar months to avoid seasonal bias const start1990 = '1990-06-01'; const end1990 = '1990-09-30'; const start2019 = '2019-06-01'; const end2019 = '2019-09-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1990, Landsat 8 for 2019 function getL5Collection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); } function getL8Collection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); } // Cloud masking function function maskLandsatClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask.not()); } // NDVI calculation function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Get collections const col1990 = getL5Collection(start1990, end1990).map(maskLandsatClouds).map(addNDVI); const col2019 = getL8Collection(start2019, end2019).map(maskLandsatClouds).map(addNDVI); // Check collection sizes const size1990 = col1990.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1990 Images: ${size1990}, 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size1990 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const composite1990 = col1990.median().select('NDVI'); const composite2019 = col2019.median().select('NDVI'); // Check valid pixels const count1990 = composite1990.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2019 = composite2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 1990: ${count1990}, 2019: ${count2019}`); if (count1990 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI const mean1990 = composite1990.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const mean2019 = composite2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Mean NDVI 1990: ${mean1990?.toFixed(3)}, 2019: ${mean2019?.toFixed(3)}`); // Validation if (mean1990 === null || mean2019 === null || isNaN(mean1990) || isNaN(mean2019) || mean1990 > 1 || mean2019 > 1 || mean1990 < -1 || mean2019 < -1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Final comparison if (mean2019 < mean1990) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
